town.label: Half out of lunal mode
town.explanation: The Borg is in lunal mode - both halves of the state set - and the stair-scum bail fires in town. The original cleared only the lunal_mode flag, leaving fleeing_lunal set: the caution phase kept treating the Borg as lunal while the mode flag said otherwise. The correction clears the pair, as the normal lunal exit does: both flags false.

before.raw:

SETUPSTEP profile
SETUP seed=1000 class=Warrior depth=0
  leaving_scumming_clears_the_lunal_pair  MODE town
GEOMETRY lunal_mode=0 fleeing_lunal=1
RATING lunal_mode=0 fleeing_lunal=1
OUTCOME lunal_mode=0 fleeing_lunal=1
Failed

pack.label: Control: the full-pack bail
pack.explanation: A full pack bails out of stair scumming before any flag is touched: both halves stay set in both variants, and the complete log is byte-identical.
